Riders and drivers lack a shared understanding of the exact, physically accessible pickup location, particularly at complex venues.
rationale: Evidence 2: primary gate/entrance confusion 13/24, wrong pin 10/24, driver could not find location 9/24; secondary only gate 2/33, pin 2/33, driver location 4/33. | Impact 2: 15/24 worried about being late; delay and walking reported, but not a lost trip by itself. | Frequency 3: gate confusion is the most-ticked primary difficulty (13/24). | Scope 3: directly about meeting at pickup. | Intervention 3: information design levers exist without presupposing a feature. | Confidence 2: mainly one small convenience survey.
method_note: Each criterion scored 1-3 (see rubric). Weighted score = sum(weight x score), range 1-3. Scores and weights are analytical judgements, not measured data. Rank checked under four weightings.

definition: Riders and drivers rely on calls, messages and additional walking to resolve uncertainty, increasing pickup effort and delay.
rationale: Evidence 2: waiting 11/24, drivers called for directions 11/24, unclear communication 8/24; secondary communication 9/33, waiting 8/33. | Impact 2: extra effort and delay. | Frequency 2: common in both, but below gate confusion in the survey and below cancellation in reviews. | Scope 3: coordination is the find-my-ride mechanism. | Intervention 2: levers exist but calls/waiting have other causes. | Confidence 2: cause of calls and waiting not separated from other causes.
method_note: Each criterion scored 1-3 (see rubric). Weighted score = sum(weight x score), range 1-3. Scores and weights are analytical judgements, not measured data. Rank checked under four weightings.

definition: Some pickup cancellations may be associated with coordination difficulties; other causes include driver availability, incentives, traffic, fares and operations.
rationale: Evidence 1 (for a coordination link): 0 of 22 cancellation reviews carry a gate or pin code; 5 also carry a fare code. | Impact 3: lost trips and fees; primary 10/24 outcomes were cancellations (rider 6, driver 4). | Frequency 3: most-cited review theme (22/33), but reviews are self-selected. | Scope 1: many causes lie outside meeting-point information. | Intervention 1: causes are mixed (availability, incentives, fares, operations). | Confidence 1: causal path untested.
